要点：复利表示已产生的利息也继续计息。估算需要初始本金、追加投入、期限、利率及复利频率。本项目计算器采用名义年利率按月复利、每月月末追加投入：月利率 = 年利率 / 12；利率为零时直接累加本金和投入。结果是固定利率的假设场景，不代表市场预测，未计税、费用或通胀。实际有效年收益率不能直接除以 12 当作月利率。

注意：适用范围、地区和产品条款可能不同，请打开官方来源核实；这不是收益承诺。

Key points: The U.S. FDIC standard limit is $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per ownership category. Accounts in the same category at one bank are aggregated; simply opening more accounts does not multiply coverage. Eligible deposits may be insured, while investments such as stocks, bonds and mutual funds are not FDIC-insured deposits. These U.S. rules do not apply to mainland China, Hong Kong or other jurisdictions. Verify bank and account eligibility. Reviewed snapshot: 2026-11-10.

Source: [deposit-us]
Caveat: Scope, jurisdiction and product terms can differ. Check the official source; this is educational, not a live or licensed purchase offer.
